messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "should not be taken for more than 2 days between 20 and 30 weeks of pregnancy"
set: ["should not be taken for more than 2 days between 20 and 30 weeks of pregnancy", "should not be taken after about 30 weeks of pregnancy", "do not take after 30 weeks of pregnancy", "taken for few days or weeks", "should not be used in early pregnancy", "dose should not be higher than prescribed", "oral granules should be taken 30 minutes before a meal", "increase to 20 mg/day after 2 weeks for adolescents and higher-weight children", "target stop date should be set within first 2 weeks of treatment", "tapering should occur for 2 weeks prior to discontinuation", "dose not increased more than once every 4 weeks", "leave no more than 12 hours between doses", "time between two doses must be at least 2 days (>48 hours)", "do not stop suddenly after more than a few days of treatment", "capsules should not be chewed", "capsules should not be opened"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
